mistake_content: Test method test_03_verify_the_position_of_the_buttons_on_the_cancel_shortcut_creation_pop_up_window_C48 is missing its mandatory docstring with TestRail URL. The method currently only has a comment '# LOCAL MISTAKE: Missing docstring with TestRail URL' instead of the required docstring format.
solution:
Add the mandatory docstring to the test method following the HPX automation framework standard (Section 7.1 - TEST FILE ANATOMY & CONVENTIONS). The docstring must contain two lines: (1) A clear description of what the test verifies, and (2) The TestRail URL linking to the test case.

Correct implementation:
```python
def test_03_verify_the_position_of_the_buttons_on_the_cancel_shortcut_creation_pop_up_window_C48(self):
    """
    Verify the buttons of cancel shortcut creation pop up window.
    TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/48
    """
    assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_add_new_shortcut_screen_title()
    assert self.hpx_shortcuts.verify_cancel_shortcut_go_back_btn()
```

Implementation steps:
1. Remove the comment '# LOCAL MISTAKE: Missing docstring with TestRail URL'
2. Add triple-quoted docstring immediately after the method definition line
3. First line: 'Verify the buttons of cancel shortcut creation pop up window.'
4. Second line: 'TestRails -> https://hp-testrail.external.hp.com/index.php?/cases/view/48'
5. Ensure proper indentation (4 spaces for docstring content)
6. Verify TestRail ID (48) matches the method name suffix '_C48'

KB Rule: Every test method following the naming convention test_XX_<description>_C<testrail_id> MUST include a docstring with the test description and TestRail URL in the exact format shown above. This maintains traceability between automated tests and the test management system, provides clear documentation, and follows HPX framework coding standards.
